stem:
Meera fixes a small torch bulb to an electric cell using two wires, as shown in the figure. The bulb lights up.

Which statement about the cell is correct?

options.text: The metal disc is the positive terminal and the metal cap is the negative terminal; the cell supplies electrical energy to the circuit.
The metal cap is the positive terminal and the metal disc is the negative terminal; the cell supplies electrical energy to the circuit.
Either end of the cell can be the positive terminal; the shape of the cap and disc does not matter.
The metal cap is the positive terminal, but the cell cannot supply energy unless two cells are joined together.

teacher.key_rationale: The metal cap of an electric cell is the positive terminal and the metal disc is the negative terminal; the cell is a source of electrical energy that drives current through the torch bulb, so it lights. Option A reverses the terminals, C ignores the terminal identity, and D wrongly claims one cell cannot power the circuit.
